subject: Kestrel status: CI green, fine-tune under way, one packaging trade-off
body:
Hi Santiago, Dmitri,

Kestrel status.

Packaging: done and CI is green - full unit-test suite passing since Mar 25, two days ahead of the milestone. The layers/models split from the repo carried over cleanly: consumers import core ETC layers without touching fine-tuning code.

Fine-tuning: Umar started on the Cirrus slice Apr 8 (we kept the April window). First long-document runs look healthy; global-local attention config reproduces the expected memory profile, and he's tracking eval against the released fine-tuning setup. Full reproduction read by Apr 24 still on track.

One trade-off needing a call: the TF1-compat path doubles our test matrix and nobody internally has asked for TF1. I propose we ship TF2-only for the paved path and keep TF1 compatibility untested-but-present, documented as such. Saves roughly a week of CI maintenance per quarter. Objections by Friday, otherwise I'll fold it into the adoption guide that way.

Jorge
